content: Dr. Khwairakpam Giten Singh has no personal conflicts of interest to declare. Institutionally, he has no current affiliations or conflicts of interest. However, he was previously involved in research on DBS (Dried Blood Spot) testing, which was supported by Gilead. This study has been completed, and the funding of £30,000 is no longer active. Dr. Roger Chou, serving as a methodologist, has no personal or institutional conflicts of interest to disclose. Mr. Michael Ninburg has no personal or institutional conflicts of interest to report. Dr. Trevor Peter has no personal or institutional conflicts of interest to declare.
